title: Polished Music Discs
description: Texture pack that gives your music discs new polished look
body:
## New textures for music discs!

### This resource pack change textures for all music discs to brand-new polished designs for a fresh look. 
The textures are pretty simple but gives much more polish to music discs thanks to that it looks much better than the vanilla ones!

<hr>

# 💽 Music discs included in resource pack
- 13
- Cat
- Block
- Chirp
- Far
- Mall
- Mellohi
- Stal
- Strad
- Ward
- Wait
- 11
- Pigstep
- Otherside
- 5
- Relic
- Creator
- Creator Music Box
- Precipice
- Tears
- Lava Chicken

# ⚙️ Technical stuff or something
- Go to my strawpage: [zuuup link](https://sniezekmod.straw.page/) for any of:
  - issues ⚠️
  -  your ideas 🧠
  -   just casual questions to me ❔
  
- Texture pack should work on every version from 1.6.1 up to 1.21.8+ but about older versions I'm just not sure how older versions would work because I don't have time to test that, most of new versions should work without any complications
  
- Instructions how to use for dummies:
  1. Just Install it
  2. Put it in the texture pack folder
  3. Turn it on and you good to go!
